import pyautogui, time
code = '''clear
cat > /tmp/b.py << 'EOF'
import re,urllib.request,os,html
from openpyxl import Workbook
def g(p,s):
    m=re.search(p,s,re.S)
    return m.group(1) if m else None
ids=[('2022','2022.acl-long.220'),('2021','2021.acl-long.571'),('2020','2020.acl-main.442'),('2019','P19-1426')]
wb=Workbook();ws=wb.active

    h=urllib.request.urlopen('https://aclanthology.org/'+i+'/').read().decode('utf-8')
    t=g('citation_title\"[^>]*content=\"(.*?)\"',h) or g('content=\"(.*?)\"[^>]*citation_title',h)
    t=html.unescape(t).strip()
    au=re.findall('citation_author\"[^>]*content=\"(.*?)\"',h) or re.findall('content=\"(.*?)\"[^>]*citation_author',h)
    au=[html.unescape(a).strip() for a in au]
    au=[' '.join([x.strip() for x in a.split(',')][::-1]) if ',' in a else a for a in au]
    p='https://aclanthology.org/'+i+'.pdf'
    print(y,'|',t,'|',', '.join(au),'|',p)
    ws.append([t,int(y),', '.join(au),p])
wb.save(os.path.expanduser('~/Desktop/best_awards_acl.xlsx'))
print('SAVED OK')
EOF
python3 /tmp/b.py

import pyautogui, time
code = '''clear
cat > /tmp/c.py << 'EOF'
import re,urllib.request,os,html
from openpyxl import Workbook
ids=[('2022','2022.acl-long.220'),('2021','2021.acl-long.571'),('2020','2020.acl-main.442'),('2019','P19-1426')]
wb=Workbook();ws=wb.active
ws.append(['Title','Year','Authors','PDF Link'])
for y,i in ids:
    h=urllib.request.urlopen('https://aclanthology.org/'+i+'/').read().decode('utf-8')
    T=None;A=[]
    for m in re.findall('<meta[^>]*>',h):
        c=re.search('content="([^"]*)"',m)
        if not c: continue
        v=html.unescape(c.group(1)).strip()
        if 'citation_title' in m and T is None: T=v
        elif 'citation_author' in m: A.append(' '.join([x.strip() for x in v.split(',')][::-1]) if ',' in v else v)
    p='https://aclanthology.org/'+i+'.pdf'
    print(y,'|',T,'|',', '.join(A),'|',p)
    ws.append([T,int(y),', '.join(A),p])
wb.save(os.path.expanduser('~/Desktop/best_awards_acl.xlsx'))
print('SAVED OK')
EOF
python3 /tmp/c.py
'''
pyautogui.click(480, 548); time.sleep(0.4); pyautogui.write(code, interval=0.005)
